courseCode.description: Course code, copy exactly e.g. CS-101

function.name: listSessions
function.description: List taught sessions, optionally one course and/or one date.

courseCode.description: Course code filter; omit for all

onDate.description: Only sessions on this date; date-only YYYY-MM-DD, never a timestamp

limit.description: Max rows to return, non-negative integer 0..50; omit for all rows

function.name: getStudent
function.description: Read a student profile and their attendance records by display name (name-valued, no id lookup).

function.name: listAttendance
function.description: List attendance rows of one status, optionally one session and/or marked-after instant.

status.description: Attendance mark; one of: present, absent, excused

sessionId.description: Session identifier filter; omit for all; opaque identifier, copy exactly, e.g. SES-01

markedAfter.description: Only rows marked at/after this instant; full instant YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM with zone Z or +HH:MM, never date-only

limit.description: Max rows to return, non-negative integer 0..50; omit for all rows
